style: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent Nexora AI workspace hero illustration. ONE centered isolated ivory white paper sculpture, thin layered sheets with softly rounded corners and pale periwinkle backing edges. Indigo #405cb0 accents, matte paper-ceramic material, almost front-facing orthographic camera with slight tilt, soft semitransparent lavender-blue shadow lower right, restrained editorial simplicity like a CV sheet with layered lavender paper depth. Square framing, 15% clear margin, transparent backdrop, no environment, no pedestal or ground. No text, letters, digits, logo, watermark, metallic gold, shiny plastic, person or mascot. No actual user data. Subject:
subjects: a single ivory paper card showing a raised indigo branching decision path with three endpoint circles, two lavender sheets offset behind it. Minimal decision-tree sculpture.

four thin ivory paper panels stacked in a gentle ascending sequence, a small raised indigo four-point star on the front panel, each panel with one short lavender embossed line. Minimal structured storytelling sculpture.
three staggered white paper steps connected by a thin indigo route ribbon, a small indigo endpoint circle at the top, lavender backing edges. Minimal career learning roadmap sculpture.

an ivory white identity card with a simple indigo abstract person silhouette emboss and three lavender horizontal lines, two thin lavender-white profile sheets layered behind. Minimal career context sculpture.

an ivory white profile card with a simple raised indigo person bust glyph and a small pale lavender circle badge, two softly offset thin lavender sheets behind. Minimal personal profile sculpture, no actual portrait.

a tall ivory white control panel card with three thin lavender horizontal tracks and small indigo slider knobs, a tiny indigo shield emboss at bottom, two thin lavender backing sheets. Minimal trustworthy settings sculpture.

a very simple ivory white paper folder holding three offset ivory report sheets, a small indigo clock glyph embossed on the front, fine lavender sheet edges. Minimal history and saved reports sculpture.
